text: question, if i put in a rig on a model, and then i need to scale the model size later on, does the rig follow the scale
resolution: Verified current character-scale behavior. Mesh Scale By is a position-only geometry operation: logical-vertex weights remain valid, but the independent skeleton does not automatically scale during that gesture. The changed shape sets fitNeedsReview; Fit Skeleton refits unlocked joints to the scaled anatomy while manual/locked joints remain fixed and must be unlocked or adjusted explicitly. No code change requested.
